summary: PMV Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K regarding an underwritten public offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants with accompanying common stock warrants. The offering includes 22,055,000 shares and 19,900,000 pre-funded warrants, each sold with a warrant, at a combined price of $1.21 per share or $1.20999 per pre-funded warrant. The common stock warrants are exercisable at $1.21 per share, expire in five years, and may be subject to price adjustments post-FDA NDA acceptance. The deal is structured as a unit offering with separable components, expected to close September 2, 2026.
